implementation: Group boundaries follow existing layer/type artwork, masks, details, board and polygon-outline order; route tail slots exist in source captures.

Compatible groups share exact meshes, private font atlas handles and GPU scenes. Stale copper or changed source IDs invalidate their group; display/font/DPI/history and incompatible preview changes invalidate reuse.
Reused scenes may begin at a nonzero mesh index; submitted callbacks initialize/update their camera when parameters differ.
CPU zoom refinement remaps each shared mesh once to the UI atlas. Group references are direct; no chain of ancestor Cache objects.

regressions: Group identity across source-to-route and fresh/stale copper
Expired scene release through weak reference after style change
GPU pixels against complete redraw, Rgba8Unorm and Rgba8UnormSrgb, dithering off/on
Source pad labels, holes/masks, split track, variable route tails, via, backtrack, highlights, draft and mirrored/single-layer states
Camera update while earlier scene mesh zero is no longer submitted
Existing CPU zoom/atlas replacement and worker invalidation

steps: Move preview: stale copper dimming and preserved stationary artwork
Place again, Escape to Finish, Ctrl+Z to clean title and original artwork

limitations: Final regular/varied combined first samples still reached 37.1903 / 33.3280 ms, one >33 ms in each run. Initial measurements were faster; no fixed latency/FPS guarantee.

Native Finish/repour/Undo changed revisions and rebuilt all groups; logged artwork costs reached 67.69 ms. Native CPU frame batches also include startup/action outliers; they are not continuous-routing FPS measurements.
Source track splits can rebuild an entire affected artwork group. Generic editing previews, display/font/DPI changes and different tessellation scale still require appropriate rebuilds.
Retaining directly referenced source scene/atlas generations consumes memory; arbitrary-board peak RAM/VRAM is not established.
Exact Altium feature/behavior/layout parity, Linux runtime and new AppImage remain open.
